newsitem.title: USA: Intel to boost stake in CNET.
newsitem.headline: Intel to boost stake in CNET.

text.p: Computer chip maker Intel Corp has agreed to increase its stake in CNET Inc to six percent from 4.5 percent, CNET said Thursday .
CNET, which integrates television programing with World Wide Web sites, said Intel will buy another 201,253 CNET common shares at $26.34 each.
The deal is worth a total of $5.3 million, it said.

"We are pleased that Intel has opted to further its strategic investment in CNET," it said. "We have worked closely on a number of projects since the initial investment in July of last year and will continue to pursue opportunities that are strategic for both companies."
